mapper.select:
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM shopion.tPrfCust C LEFT OUTER JOIN shopion.tPrfComp Comp ON C.CompCode = Comp.CompCode LEFT OUTER JOIN shopion.tPrfBranch B ON C.CompCode = B.CompCode AND C.BranchId = B.BranchId LEFT OUTER JOIN shopion.tPrfDept D ON C.BranchId = D.BranchId AND C.DeptCode = D.DeptCode LEFT OUTER JOIN shopion.tPrfDuty Dt ON C.CompCode = Dt.CompCode AND C.DutyId = Dt.DutyId LEFT OUTER JOIN shopion.tPrfCustGroup CG ON C.CustGroupCode = CG.CustGroupCode LEFT OUTER JOIN shopion.tStrChnl Ch ON C.ChnlCode = Ch.ChnlCode
AND Ch.SvcCode = #{pSvcCode} AND C.ChnlCode = #{pChnlCode} AND C.CustGroupCode = #{pCustGroupCode} AND C.CustName LIKE CONCAT('%',#{pCustName},'%') AND C.LoginId LIKE CONCAT('%',#{pLoginId},'%') AND C.CustId = #{pCustId}

SELECT C.*, CG.CustGroupName AS CustGroupName, Comp.CompName, Comp.CompLogoImg, B.BranchName, D.DeptName, Dt.DutyName, Ch.ChnlName FROM shopion.tPrfCust C LEFT OUTER JOIN shopion.tPrfComp Comp ON C.CompCode = Comp.CompCode LEFT OUTER JOIN shopion.tPrfBranch B ON C.CompCode = B.CompCode AND C.BranchId = B.BranchId LEFT OUTER JOIN shopion.tPrfDept D ON C.BranchId = D.BranchId AND C.DeptCode = D.DeptCode LEFT OUTER JOIN shopion.tPrfDuty Dt ON C.CompCode = Dt.CompCode AND C.DutyId = Dt.DutyId LEFT OUTER JOIN shopion.tPrfCustGroup CG ON C.CustGroupCode = CG.CustGroupCode LEFT OUTER JOIN shopion.tStrChnl Ch ON C.ChnlCode = Ch.ChnlCode WHERE C.CustId = #{value}

SELECT C.*, CG.CustGroupName AS CustGroupName, Comp.CompName, Comp.CompLogoImg, B.BranchName, D.DeptName, Dt.DutyName, Ch.ChnlName FROM shopion.tPrfCust C LEFT OUTER JOIN shopion.tPrfComp Comp ON C.CompCode = Comp.CompCode LEFT OUTER JOIN shopion.tPrfBranch B ON C.CompCode = B.CompCode AND C.BranchId = B.BranchId LEFT OUTER JOIN shopion.tPrfDept D ON C.BranchId = D.BranchId AND C.DeptCode = D.DeptCode LEFT OUTER JOIN shopion.tPrfDuty Dt ON C.CompCode = Dt.CompCode AND C.DutyId = Dt.DutyId LEFT OUTER JOIN shopion.tPrfCustGroup CG ON C.CustGroupCode = CG.CustGroupCode LEFT OUTER JOIN shopion.tStrChnl Ch ON C.ChnlCode = Ch.ChnlCode WHERE C.LoginId = #{loginId}
AND EXISTS (SELECT M.ChnlCode FROM shopion.tStrChnl M WHERE M.ChnlCode = C.ChnlCode AND M.MemberChnlCode = #{memberChnlCode})

SELECT C.*, CG.CustGroupName AS CustGroupName, Comp.CompName, Comp.CompLogoImg, B.BranchName, D.DeptName, Dt.DutyName, Ch.ChnlName FROM shopion.tPrfCust C LEFT OUTER JOIN shopion.tPrfComp Comp ON C.CompCode = Comp.CompCode LEFT OUTER JOIN shopion.tPrfBranch B ON C.CompCode = B.CompCode AND C.BranchId = B.BranchId LEFT OUTER JOIN shopion.tPrfDept D ON C.BranchId = D.BranchId AND C.DeptCode = D.DeptCode LEFT OUTER JOIN shopion.tPrfDuty Dt ON C.CompCode = Dt.CompCode AND C.DutyId = Dt.DutyId LEFT OUTER JOIN shopion.tPrfCustGroup CG ON C.CustGroupCode = CG.CustGroupCode LEFT OUTER JOIN shopion.tStrChnl Ch ON C.ChnlCode = Ch.ChnlCode WHERE C.CustName = #{custName} AND EXISTS (SELECT M.ChnlCode FROM shopion.tStrChnl M WHERE M.ChnlCode = C.ChnlCode AND M.MemberChnlCode = #{memberChnlCode}) AND C.Email = #{email} AND C.CustCode = #{custCode} AND C.LoginId = #{loginId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO shopion.tPrfCust ( CustName, Email, HomePhoneNo, MobilePhoneNo, MobileSvc, Zipcode, Addr1, Addr2, LoginId, Passwd, CustCode, CustGroupCode, ChnlCode, MailReciptYn, SmsReciptYn, Birth, BirthType, MarryYn, MarryAnnivs, MarryAnnivsType, RecomId, AreaCode, JobType, StoreCode, CompCode, BranchId, DeptCode, DutyId, State, Remark, RegistDate, RegistId, RegistName ) VALUES ( #{custName}, #{email}, #{homePhoneNo}, #{mobilePhoneNo}, #{mobileSvc}, #{zipcode}, #{addr1}, #{addr2}, #{loginId}, #{passwd}, #{custCode}, #{custGroupCode}, #{chnlCode}, #{mailReciptYn}, #{smsReciptYn}, #{birth}, #{birthType}, #{marryYn}, #{marryAnnivs}, #{marryAnnivsType}, #{recomId}, #{areaCode}, #{jobType}, #{storeCode}, #{compCode}, #{branchId}, #{deptCode}, #{dutyId}, #{state}, #{remark}, NOW(), #{registId}, #{registName} )
mapper.update: UPDATE shopion.tPrfCust SET CustName = #{custName}, Email = #{email}, HomePhoneNo = #{homePhoneNo}, MobilePhoneNo = #{mobilePhoneNo}, MobileSvc = #{mobileSvc}, Zipcode = #{zipcode}, Addr1 = #{addr1}, Addr2 = #{addr2}, CustGroupCode = #{custGroupCode}, Passwd = #{passwd}, MailReciptYn = #{mailReciptYn}, SmsReciptYn = #{smsReciptYn}, Birth = #{birth}, BirthType = #{birthType}, MarryYn = #{marryYn}, MarryAnnivs = #{marryAnnivs}, MarryAnnivsType = #{marryAnnivsType}, AreaCode = #{areaCode}, JobType = #{jobType}, StoreCode = #{storeCode}, DutyId = #{dutyId}, State = #{state}, Remark = #{remark}, ChangeDate = NOW(), ChangeId = #{changeId}, ChangeName = #{changeName} WHERE CustId = #{custId}
